personality_one_liner: A professional, highly legible, and native-feeling interface that bridges enterprise fleet management with a consumer-friendly rental experience.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Clear grouping. Intentional padding. Thumb-zone focus.

do's: Bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Featured/hero cards frosted glass overlay on brand-tinted or photo backdrop

screens.name: Auth / Role Selection
screens.purpose: Secure entry point with explicit path selection for Locador (Owner) vs Locatário (Renter).
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) at the bottom. The content sits in the bottom 40%: App logo/title, subtitle, and two large pill buttons for role selection, stacked vertically.

screens.name: Locador Dashboard (Owner)
screens.purpose: A modular control center for the fleet manager showing real-time metrics, alerts, and quick actions.

states.loading: Skeleton of metric cards and list rows
states.empty: Illustration of a parked car, 'Adicione seu primeiro veículo' (Add your first vehicle) + CTA
states.error: Readable error message with a 'Tentar Novamente' button

screens.layout: Safe area header. Top section features a horizontal scroll of metric cards (Total earnings, Active Rentals, Pending Maintenance) using brandTertiary tints. Below, a 'Veículos Ativos' (Active Vehicles) modular list. Status badges (success/warning) indicate vehicle health/contract status. Bottom sticky tab bar with glass effect.

screens.name: Locatário Home (Renter Marketplace)
screens.purpose: Browse available cars for rent with high-quality imagery and upfront pricing.

states.empty: Empty road illustration, 'Nenhum carro disponível no momento' + Filter reset CTA

screens.layout: Search/Filter bar at the top (sticky with glass effect). Below, a stacked list of large car cards (surfaceSecondary). Each card has a prominent image, title (Make/Model), features as small chips, and a right-aligned price. The layout uses generous lg padding and avoids dense data.

screens.name: Car Details & Booking
screens.purpose: Provides full vehicle information, maintenance status, and initiates the digital contract process.

states.error: Failed to load details + Retry CTA

screens.layout: Hero image at the top with a back button (glass circle). Scrolling content below: Title, status badge, specs grid (2-col), maintenance log preview, and contract terms. A fixed bottom container (surface or glass) houses the primary CTA ('Assinar Contrato' / 'Book Now') spanning 100% width, respecting safe area.

screens.name: Contract & Maintenance Tracker (Shared)
screens.purpose: View active contract terms, payment history, and scheduled maintenance.
screens.layout: Tabbed view or segmented control (Contracts | Payments | Maintenance). List items use leading icons in brandTertiary tinted squares. Payment statuses use clear success/error text colors. For tracking, a visual timeline or progress tracker indicates the contract lifecycle or maintenance schedule.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design Identity: Adopt the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality. Do NOT use ANY blue, indigo, or purple. Use the provided Moss Green (#4A5D23) for all primary branding/accents.
Navigation Structure: Implement two distinct tab-based navigation trees based on the user's role (Locador vs. Locatário) determined at Auth.

Role - Locador: Focus on a dashboard UI. Use a modular card layout for top-level metrics, keeping data highly legible and utilizing status colors (success, warning) for fleet health and contract alerts.
Role - Locatário: Focus on an e-commerce/marketplace feel. The home screen should prominently feature high-quality car images, clear pricing, and a smooth booking flow.

Glassmorphism: Use Expo's blur for the bottom tab bar and sticky headers. For hero images with text overlays (like the Auth screen), absolutely implement a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG text contrast.
Spacing & Interaction: Ensure all primary actions (like 'Assinar Contrato') are housed in a sticky bottom container that clears the safe area. Hit targets must be at least 44x44pt.
Visual Hierarchy: Rely on font size and spacing for hierarchy instead of heavy font weights (max 500 weight). Use Plus Jakarta Sans throughout, ensuring a clean, modern aesthetic.
